name: task-tracker
description: Task Tracking Web App: A PWA supported app that provides deeply nested tasks, lists, sublists, spaces. Supports space collaboration, email notifications, guest mode and CSV/JSON exports.

paragraphs: Task Tracker is a mobile-first, installable task manager with nested subtasks, inspired by the list view in ClickUp and Linear. Work is organised as spaces > lists > sublists > tasks.
features: Home screen - priority tasks, recent tasks, recent lists and sublists, with quick actions (new task, spaces, search)
Nested tasks - subtasks up to 3 levels deep, grouped by status with collapsible sections
Statuses per space - default To Do / In Progress / Done plus custom statuses with colours
Priority - star a task to float it above the rest of its siblings; a starred parent carries its subtasks with it. Drag reordering works within each tier
Drag and drop - reorder sibling tasks, spaces, lists and sublists

whatItDoes.text: Task Tracker is a mobile-first, installable task manager with nested subtasks, inspired by the list view in ClickUp and Linear. Work is organised as spaces > lists > sublists > tasks.

requirements.text: Accounts - email sign-up with confirmation, login, password reset, and per-IP / per-email lockouts
Supabase's captcha applies to every password login too and would break login.
